tagline: QUICK COMMERCE GOT FASTER. CATEGORY CHOICE GOT HARDER.
title: 1. Users Repeat Grocery Routine Orders in Sub-45s Checkouts Without Exploring High-Margin Categories
subtitle: High delivery speed drives daily staple retention, but routine habit loops create category tunnel vision.
brief: Role & Scope: PM on Zepto Growth Team driving non-grocery cross-category trial.
scale_vs_collapse: Routine Tunnel Vision: 71.2% review-mention share of grocery staples in synthetic corpus shows heavy grocery discussion dominance [Synthetic Corpus, 2,000 items].
The Margin Disconnect: Daily staples yield ~10% gross margin vs 35%–50% for Beauty & Pet Care [Illustrative Assumption].
Strategic Objective: Lift Monthly Active Customers (MAC) buying from 2+ categories from 8.2% to 28.4% [Illustrative Target].
Margin Formula: Blended Margin = (Grocery % * 10%) + (Non-Grocery % * 40%) -> Unlocks +300bps EBITDA [Illustrative Modeling Estimate].

tagline: AD BANNERS SPAM CHECKOUTS. USERS ABANDON NEW CATEGORIES OVER HIDDEN RISK.
title: 2. Platforms Optimized 10-Minute Logistics Speed but Ignored Risk-Free Product Trial
subtitle: Ad banners fail because users abandon non-grocery discovery over invisible quality and return risks.

blind_spot_unsolved.status: ❌ 83% buy planned non-grocery outside QCommerce (20/24) [Survey, N=24]
❌ 17% cite refund chatbot loops as top barrier (4/24) [Survey Q4, N=24]

core_thesis: Users abandon non-grocery discovery not because they lack desire, but because the financial and quality cost of a wrong/expired non-grocery buy is invisible until delivered.

tagline: THE PROBLEM ISN'T BANNER VISIBILITY. IT'S FINANCIAL & QUALITY RISK BEFORE CHECKOUT.
title: 3. Users Abandon New Categories Over Hidden Quality & Choice Risk, Not Lack of Awareness
subtitle: Synthesis of synthetic complaint patterns and primary survey responses isolates core purchase blockers.

survey_stats.label: Power Users Ordering Weekly or More (19/24)

quotes: "Quality & Expiry Fear: 20.1% of discovery subset (134/667) fear heat degrades dark store items. [Synthetic Corpus]"
"Planned Buy Mismatch: 33% of surveyed users (8/24) cite planned bulk-buy habit mismatch as primary barrier. [Survey Q4, N=24]"
"Return Bot Uncertainty: 17% of surveyed users (4/24) cite refund chatbot loops as top blocker. [Survey Q4, N=24]"
conclusion: Users don't need intrusive checkout banner ads. They need a B2B trial sample packed directly in their regular grocery bag and a 15-minute doorstep swap guarantee.

steps.title: 0-CAC Brand Trial

steps.title: Category Streaks

steps.title: Doorstep Swap
steps.desc: 15-minute doorstep replacement guarantee for damaged/wrong items [92% survey response, 22/24].

tagline: FROM A TYPED GROCERY CART TO A TRUSTED CROSS-CATEGORY ORDER. SAME APP, TWO VIEWS.

Brand sample inventory ledger tracking sample distribution and conversion rates.

tagline: EVERY METRIC IS TIED TO THE NORTH STAR: MONTHLY CATEGORY EXPLORATION RATE (MCER).
title: 9. Success Is Measured by Monthly Category Exploration Rate (MCER) Growth
subtitle: Primary conversion metric supported by operational SLA and margin guardrails.
north_star: Monthly Category Exploration Rate (MCER): % of Monthly Active Customers purchasing from 2+ categories/month.
guardrails: Picker SLA Floor: Packing time addition capped at <3 seconds per order (zero hardware for MVP).
Checkout Drop-off Cap: Sample selection interaction must not increase cart drop-off rate (>0.2%).
S3 Cloud Cost Ceiling: AWS S3 photo storage capped below $20/month via 7-day TTL rules (Horizon 2 expansion).
